seo.title: Features - PriceM8
seo.description: See all features of PriceM8: weekly price updates, trade packs, fast quote builder, PDF quotes and team access. Built for UK trades.

sections.title: Everything you need to price jobs fast, accurately and stress-free.
sections.subtitle: Built for tradies, designed through 20 years of real construction experience.

sections.title: Weekly Updated Material Prices
sections.subtitle: Accurate prices, updated automatically.
paragraphs: Material prices change constantly. PriceM8 keeps your numbers sharp with weekly cost updates sourced from real UK suppliers. You don't need to sync anything — updates happen in the background.
Users can also add their own materials and update those manually at any time.

sections.title: Consistency You Can Bank On
sections.subtitle: Stop gambling with AI estimates. Get the same price, every time.
paragraphs: Generic AI apps guess prices based on photos. PriceM8 uses deterministic data to calculate exactly what you need.
100m² of paving always costs the same. No hallucinations, no random numbers.

sections.title: Trade Packs
sections.subtitle: Start with a ready-made pack - then customise everything.
paragraphs: Pick your trade pack when you first sign up. Packs include typical tasks, materials and labour items for your trade. You can edit, customise or build new packs from scratch.
Trade packs save hours on quoting and help keep everything consistent.

sections.title: Quote Builder
sections.subtitle: Professional quotes in minutes - not hours.
paragraphs: PriceM8 handles the maths so you can focus on the job. Create unlimited quotes, save clients and projects, and calculate labour, materials, overhead and profit instantly.

sections.title: Instant PDF Quotes
sections.subtitle: Client-ready, professional documents.
paragraphs: Generate clean, branded PDF quotes with your logo, business details, pricing breakdown and custom terms. Perfect for sending on WhatsApp, email or SMS.

sections.title: Team Access
sections.subtitle: Designed for growing businesses.
paragraphs: PriceM8 supports teams with shared access to quotes, packs and materials. Add multiple users, collaborate on pricing and stay consistent across jobs.

sections.title: Smart Waste Management
sections.subtitle: Optimized waste disposal that saves hundreds.
paragraphs: Waste disposal is one of the biggest hidden costs in landscaping and building. PriceM8 doesn't just guess - it calculates the exact volume of soil, rubble, or mixed waste based on your job dimensions.
Our engine applies bulking factors (taking into account how soil expands once dug) and finds the most cost-effective combination of 6yd/8yd skips or grab lorries for your specific project.

sections.title: Adaptive Scheduler
sections.subtitle: A diary that knows when you're on site.
paragraphs: Most calendars are just static lists. The PriceM8 Adaptive Scheduler tracks your logged hours against the quote. If a job overruns, it doesn't just move everything - it intelligently shifts only the *remaining* work.
It respects your specific working hours, break times, and blocked holidays, so your projects always land on a working day.
bullets: Shifts remaining work based on logged hours
Custom working days and break times

sections.title: Profit Safeguard
sections.subtitle: Stop working for free.
paragraphs: PriceM8 and its unique risk-scoring engine flags jobs that look risky before you hit send. It analyzes your profit-per-person-day, labour-to-material ratios, and overall margin.
If a job is likely to lose money due to low margin or unrealistic labour hours, PriceM8 alerts you so you can fix the quote first.

sections.title: AI Task Helper
sections.subtitle: Professional descriptions in seconds.
paragraphs: Struggling to describe a complex job? Just type a few keywords and let our AI write a professional, detailed task description for your quote.
It helps you sound more professional and ensures you don't miss key details.

sections.title: Client Portal
sections.subtitle: Look like a pro from day one.
paragraphs: Give your clients a dedicated link to view their quotes, approve work, share documents and message you directly.
Keep all communication in one place and stop chasing emails and texts.

sections.title: Spend less time quoting. Spend more time earning.
